Founder & Lead Consultant Surgeon

Dr. MuhammadSalman Khan

“Build private healthcare with the surgical rigor of the best hospitals — and the experience patients should expect internationally.”

Dr. Salman is a board-certified plastic surgeon with an MBBS from Khyber Medical College and FCPS in Plastic Surgery. His practice grew from a single clinic in Peshawar into a multi-city platform serving patients from Pakistan and abroad. His work spans hair restoration, rhinoplasty, body contouring, facelifts and non-surgical rejuvenation.

International trainer & speakerMasterclasses and live demonstrations across Turkey, Thailand, the Philippines, Oman and the UAE.
Global patient basePatients have travelled from the UK, Canada, Gulf states, Central Asia and beyond.
